Tiêu đề đề bài: Part 2 - Situation 1: Advising a Helper-Minded Friend on a Health & Wellness Career
Nội dung chi tiết:
Situation: Your close friend has a genuine passion for helping people lead healthier lives and wants to transition into the wellness field. He is considering three career paths:
- Becoming a personal fitness trainer (huấn luyện viên thể hình cá nhân)
- Working as a certified nutritionist (chuyên gia tư vấn dinh dưỡng)
- Pursuing a career as a wellness and life coach (huấn luyện viên phong cách sống và sức khỏe toàn diện)
Which option do you think is the best choice and why?
